small: Use case: stylized-concept. Game VFX sprite: one SMALL RASENGAN projectile for Naruto's basic attacks in a 2D anime autochess game. Single compact cyan-blue spinning chakra sphere, bright white-blue center, clearly visible curling spiral bands, a very short wispy blue tail pointing left, travelling right. Crisp hand-painted anime game effect, readable at 32 pixels. Sphere centered, occupies 65 percent of square canvas. Isolated effect only, genuinely transparent alpha background, soft translucent glow, generous transparent padding, no person, no hands, no text, no border, no grid, no black backdrop. Square PNG.
large: Use case: stylized-concept. Game VFX sprite: one LARGE RASENGAN impact/explosion for Naruto's special skill in a 2D anime autochess game. Single centered bright cyan-blue sphere with dense white-blue curling spiral energy bands, surrounded by a circular expanding swirling chakra shockwave and a few radial blue energy wisps. Circular symmetrical composition viewed straight-on, exceptionally readable at 160 pixels, crisp anime hand-painted effect. Energy fills 85 percent of square canvas, generous transparent padding so no glow clipped. Isolated VFX only, genuinely transparent alpha background including gaps between wisps, soft translucent blue glow. No character, no hand, no terrain, no text, no border, no grid, no black backdrop. Square PNG.
